name: 31029 · Forsyth, GA
findings: ZIP 31029 (Forsyth) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31029 (Forsyth) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
